notes: Baxtel lists LCRDC Liverpool City King Edward as an operating facility; LCRDC describes multiple edge, micro and core colocation locations across Liverpool City Region. Capacity not stated at facility level in public source.

name: LCRDC Bootle Hornby edge data centre

name: Equinix Manchester MA1 / MA4 Science Park campus
